calendar.climate_note: Edinburgh's cool maritime climate and high latitude delay spring budburst and prolong a cool, gradual autumn leaf-fall.

stages.budburst: Bronze-tinged pleated young leaves emerging from swollen buds along grey branches.
stages.full_leaf: Broad dark green palmate leaves with hanging green samara clusters; grey scaly bark.
stages.colouring: Deep green leaves fading unevenly to dull greenish-yellow with dark leaf spots.
stages.peak: Warm dull yellow and brown-tinged palmate foliage across heavy scaffold limbs.
stages.falling: Yellow and brown leaves dropping rapidly from heavy limbs, revealing flaking grey bark.
stages.dormant: Bare grey flaking-plated trunk and heavy multi-forking scaffold limbs with blunt buds.

stages.budburst: Rough bright-green leaf sprigs unfurling on arching twigs after small flower clusters.
stages.full_leaf: Large, rough-textured, asymmetrical dark green leaves along arching primary boughs.
stages.colouring: Rough foliage shifting to pale lime-green and butter-yellow from outer branch tips.
stages.peak: Bright golden-yellow rough leaves glowing across wide arching branches.
stages.falling: Crisp golden and brown leaves shedding steadily, exposing arching vase-like limbs.
stages.dormant: Bare vase-shaped crown of arching grey limbs with dark, fissured bark and stout buds.

stages.budburst: Glossy reddish buds opening to tender heart-shaped light-green leaves.
stages.full_leaf: Heart-shaped dark green leaves with pale undersides; straight deeply furrowed trunk.
stages.colouring: Dark green heart-shaped leaves turning pale greenish-yellow across the crown.
stages.peak: Rich clear yellow heart-shaped foliage cloaking the rounded crown.
stages.falling: Golden-yellow leaves falling freely, revealing dense fine twigs and furrowed trunk.
stages.dormant: Bare dense rounded crown of fine twigs and single straight deeply furrowed grey trunk.
